interpretation_policies.four_state_evidence: Strict separation between factual truth (supported, refuted, unknown, conflicting) and legal disposition.
interpretation_policies.alternative_routes: A failed prerequisite indispensable to all routes yields conditions_unmet. A demonstrably refuted condition across all available routes yields conditions_unmet. An unresolved alternative preserves whole-case unresolved.
interpretation_policies.prohibition_standard: Prohibited under reviewed rule requires an applicable, explicit reviewed prohibition norm (e.g. rule:priv:02, rule:over:02). Absence of a power/grant alone cannot manufacture a prohibition.
interpretation_policies.independence_invariant: Authored and frozen prior to inspection of candidate production evaluator code; first disagreements are preserved.

amendment_policy: Any future expectation change requires an explicit signed adjudication entry preserving prior digest, successor digest, and justification.
